userStories.title: Create Android project scaffold with Gradle build system
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a complete Android project scaffold with Gradle Kotlin DSL, Jetpack Compose, Hilt DI, Room, ML Kit, OkHttp, WorkManager, and all necessary dependencies so the Android app can be built and developed alongside the iOS app.
acceptanceCriteria: android/ directory created with standard Gradle project structure
build.gradle.kts with compileSdk 35, minSdk 29, targetSdk 35
Dependencies include Compose BOM, Room, Hilt, ML Kit, OkHttp, WorkManager, DataStore, Billing, Security-Crypto
AndroidManifest.xml with INTERNET, READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, POST_NOTIFICATIONS, calendar, biometric permissions
Deep link intent filters for seddly:// and https://seddly.com/c/ schemes
Share intent filter for image/* MIME type
Network security config with cleartext disabled and Supabase certificate pinning
Data extraction rules disabling cloud backup of sensitive data
ProGuard rules for Room entities, serialization, OkHttp, and ML Kit
Application class with HiltAndroidApp, WorkManager config, and notification channels
userStories.notes: Complete Gradle project at android/ with Kotlin DSL. compileSdk 35, minSdk 29. All dependencies configured: Compose BOM 2024.12, Room 2.6.1, Hilt 2.54, ML Kit 16.0.1, OkHttp 4.12, WorkManager 2.10, Security-Crypto 1.1.0-alpha06, Billing 7.1.1. AndroidManifest with deep links, share target, network security config with Supabase cert pinning. Data extraction rules block backup. ProGuard configured. SeddlyApplication with HiltWorkerFactory and notification channels.

userStories.title: Build Room database with all data models and DAOs
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Room database entities, DAOs, and repository mirroring the iOS SwiftData models so the Android app has the same data capabilities with proper indexing, soft delete, and type-safe queries.
acceptanceCriteria: CommitmentEntity with all fields matching iOS LocalCommitment (id, entityName, summary, fullText, deadline, dollarAmount, status, confidenceScore, aiReasoning, source, category, screenshotUri, notes, syncStatus, etc.)
EntityProfile matching iOS LocalEntity with name uniqueness
ProcessingQueueEntry matching iOS ProcessingQueue with status tracking
PrivacyAuditEntry matching iOS PrivacyAuditEntry with event types
All enums (CommitmentStatus, CommitmentType, CommitmentSource, CommitmentCategory, SyncStatus, ProcessingStatus) with fromValue() factories
Computed properties: isOverdue, urgencyLevel on CommitmentEntity
EntityWithStats with accountabilityScore (0-100), accountabilityGrade (A-F), fulfillmentRate
CommitmentDao with observeAll, observePaginated, search, bulkUpdateStatus, markOverdueCommitments, soft delete
Database indexes on status+deadline, entity_name, sync_status, created_at, needs_ai_processing
CommitmentRepository with entity auto-creation on commitment insert (case-insensitive dedup)
userStories.notes: Four Room entities created: CommitmentEntity, EntityProfile, ProcessingQueueEntry, PrivacyAuditEntry. All enums with raw string values and fromValue() companion factories. CommitmentEntity has isOverdue and urgencyLevel computed properties. EntityWithStats with accountability scoring matching iOS formula. CommitmentDao with full CRUD, paginated queries, search, bulk operations, markOverdueCommitments. Indexes on key query columns. CommitmentRepository handles entity auto-creation with case-insensitive name dedup.

LedgerScreen with LazyColumn, search, status filter dropdown, sort options, swipe-to-fulfill/dismiss, FAB for manual entry
CommitmentCard with status color indicator, entity name, summary, deadline with urgency coloring, confidence badge, dollar amount, swipe gestures
CommitmentDetailScreen with status header, entity name, summary (editable), details card (deadline, amount, category, source, created), AI reasoning, notes, fulfill/dismiss/delete actions
ManualEntryScreen with entity name, summary, category dropdown, date picker, dollar amount (with validation), notes, save button
SettingsScreen with subscription info, privacy audit log count, biometric toggle, export, delete all data with confirmation dialog
Empty state for ledger with illustration and add button
Deep link navigation to commitment detail via seddly://commitment/{id}
Bulk selection mode with long-press, multi-select, bulk fulfill/dismiss
Past deadline warning on date picker in both ManualEntry and CommitmentDetail
userStories.notes: Full Compose UI built: SeddlyNavHost with bottom nav, deep link handling. LedgerScreen with TopAppBar (overdue count), search bar (animated), filter dropdown, status filter chips, LazyColumn with CommitmentCard (swipe-to-dismiss, status indicator, urgency colors, confidence badge), FAB, empty state, bulk selection with long-press. CommitmentDetailScreen with scrollable detail, status header card, editable summary, details card, AI reasoning, notes, fulfill/dismiss/delete with confirmation dialogs, date picker. ManualEntryScreen with full form validation including amount parsing and past-deadline warning. SettingsScreen with grouped sections.

userStories.title: Build OCR + AI extraction service pipeline with security
userStories.description: As a developer, I need on-device OCR via ML Kit and AI extraction via Supabase Edge Functions with prompt injection protection, request deduplication, caching, and privacy audit logging so screenshots can be processed into commitments securely.
acceptanceCriteria: OCRService using ML Kit TextRecognition with image downsampling (max 2048px)
AIExtractionService calling extract-commitments Edge Function with Bearer auth
XML tag stripping (sanitizeUserInput) to prevent prompt injection boundary escape
Suspicious pattern detection (detectSuspiciousPatterns) for common injection phrases
Request deduplication via Mutex + in-flight request map
5-minute result cache with TTL expiry
Retry with exponential backoff (max 3 attempts, handles 429 rate limiting)
X-Request-ID header on all API requests for end-to-end tracing
Privacy audit logging for every AI extraction call
ScreenshotProcessingWorker with rule-based scoring heuristic (commitment signals, dates, dollars, hedging penalties)
StatusUpdateWorker for background overdue marking
Unit tests for sanitization, pattern detection, rule scoring, and entity scoring
userStories.notes: OCRService with ML Kit TextRecognition, loadBitmap from URI, downsampleIfNeeded (2048px max). AIExtractionService with sanitizeUserInput (XML tag stripping), detectSuspiciousPatterns (8 injection phrases), Mutex-based dedup, ConcurrentHashMap cache (5min TTL), exponential backoff retry (3 attempts), X-Request-ID header, privacy audit logging. ScreenshotProcessingWorker with full pipeline: queue → OCR → rule score → AI → save. Rule scoring: commitment signals (capped at 4×10), date patterns (+15), dollar patterns (+15), hedging penalties (-10). StatusUpdateWorker for overdue marking. 5 test files with 35+ test cases covering entities, enums, sanitization, injection detection, rule scoring, auth service.

userStories.title: Add encrypted token storage with EncryptedSharedPreferences
userStories.description: As a security-conscious user, I need my authentication tokens stored using Android Keystore-backed encryption so they are protected even if the device is rooted.
acceptanceCriteria: SecureStorageService using EncryptedSharedPreferences with AES256_GCM value encryption
AES256_SIV key encryption to prevent enumeration
MasterKey backed by Android Keystore hardware security module
Storage keys defined as constants (access_token, refresh_token, token_expiry, user_id)
Graceful error handling — read/write failures logged, not thrown
clearAll() method for account deletion
Data excluded from cloud backup via data_extraction_rules.xml
userStories.notes: SecureStorageService created with EncryptedSharedPreferences but needs integration test verification on device. data_extraction_rules.xml excludes sharedpref and database from backup.

userStories.title: Add session timeout and auth event logging
userStories.description: As a security-conscious user, I need the app to automatically invalidate my session after 15 minutes of inactivity and log all auth events for auditing.
acceptanceCriteria: AuthService tracks lastActivityTimestamp updated on each validAccessToken() call
After 15 minutes of inactivity, next validAccessToken() call triggers signOut()
Auth events (signIn, signOut, tokenRefresh, sessionTimeout, refreshFailed) logged
Session timeout constant configurable (default 15 minutes)
Token refresh with 60-second expiry buffer
Unit tests for session timeout, sign-in/sign-out, token validation
userStories.notes: AuthService created with session timeout logic and event logging. Auth test file written. Needs integration testing.
